summary_en: 13,300 shares acquired for ¥28.3M (0.2% of shares outstanding) via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market methods in June 2026. Cumulative purchases since May 1, 2026 total 124,100 shares for ¥270.6M, representing 62.1% of the authorized 200,000-share (2.86% S/O) program capped at ¥500M through March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Open-Market Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Yoshicon Co., Ltd. filed notice on July 1, 2026 of treasury-share acquisitions completed in June 2026 under authorization granted by the Board on April 30, 2026. The company purchased 13,300 shares for ¥28.3M during the month of June via ToSTNeT-3 and open-market methods on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. This represents 0.2% of shares outstanding (computed as 13,300 ÷ 6,988,100 ex-treasury shares). As of June 30, 2026, cumulative acquisitions since May 1 total 124,100 shares for ¥270.6M against an authorized ceiling of 200,000 shares (2.86% of shares outstanding) valued at up to ¥500M, with execution window through March 31, 2027. The buyback is conducted under Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied via Article 165(2) provisions.
